status: proposed construction - calculated, not built or measured
construction: 2 identical transformers in parallel (primaries in parallel, secondaries in parallel), each on 2 x DMEGC EE80 DMR95 stacked, 11:12, P-S-P interleaved litz 0.05 mm, vacuum-potted in an aluminium housing on the cold plate; matched pair

electrical.L_leak_tol: +/-20 % per unit; the two units matched within +/-5 % (current sharing)

gap.type: non-magnetic spacer in all three legs (centre and outer legs)
gap.note: ground to A_L for L_m; fringing included

core.asian_alternative: TDG TP4A or DMEGC DMR96A (lower loss at 100 C, table only) in the same EE80 set - RFQ
core.western_reference: TDK N95 / Ferroxcube 3C95 E 80/38/20 x2 per stack

windings.name: primary part 1
windings.conductor: profiled litz 5858 x 0.05 mm (grade 1), 6.6 x 2.8 mm over the copper bundle, served + 0.25 mm polyimide wrap

windings.name: secondary
windings.conductor: profiled litz 5369 x 0.05 mm (grade 1), 3.0 x 5.6 mm over the copper bundle, served + 0.25 mm polyimide wrap

windings.name: primary part 2
windings.conductor: profiled litz 5858 x 0.05 mm (grade 1), 8.0 x 2.3 mm over the copper bundle, served + 0.25 mm polyimide wrap

insulation.system: vacuum-potted (thermally conductive epoxy >= 1.5 W/mK, void-free) - REQUIRED; one-piece former (2 mm GF-PBT/PPS) with flanges; P-S barriers 2.0 mm (Nomex 410 2 x 0.25 mm + polyimide film 4 x 0.05 mm + impregnation), each barrier overlapping the winding edges by >= 4 mm (P-S creepage >= 10 mm inside the potting vs 7.5 mm PD1); 5 mm margins at both winding ends (winding-core creepage >= 5 mm, PD2 value); terminations brought out on opposite sides (port 1 / port 2) with >= 20 mm creepage on the housing (PD2, IIIa) or 10 mm with CTI >= 600

levels.label: Basic DAB port 1 - port 2 (transformer, simple separation)
Basic DAB port 1 - PE, AC node (module, T1 core)
Reinforced DAB port 1 - PELV, AC node (drivers, T1 NTC)

insulation.routine_tests: P-S AC 3323 V rms 60 s (or 4700 V DC); windings-core AC 2200 V rms; PD <= 10 pC at 3149 V pk (P-S) and 1799 V pk (windings-core); NTC-winding 4400 V rms
insulation.type_tests: impulse 6 kV 1.2/50 P-S and windings-core; PD at 1.2 x; thermal run on the cold plate

core.formula: P_core = Ve*k*f^alpha*B^beta (Steinmetz, DMR95 at 100 C) x iGSE shape; B = V*t/(2*N1*Ae) per unit

winding.referred_to: port 1, the two units in parallel
winding.formula: P_cu = sum_h R(h) * I1_h,rms^2 (I1 = total port-1 current of the pair; I2 = I1*N1/N2)

loss_table.point: spec I1_rms_max 137.3 A (shape of v2low_94A) + 950 V flux

loss_grid.note: P_cu at the worst-point current shape scaled with I^2; P_core vs B_pk for the SPS trapezoid flux (iGSE)

thermal.basis: own 2-node estimate per unit: winding faces outside the core window -> 3 mm potting (1.5 W/mK) -> Al housing -> 0.5 mm gap pad -> cold plate; window faces -> potting -> core -> plate; to be confirmed by a thermal run
thermal.interface: each unit potted in an Al housing (base >= 6 mm) bolted to the cold plate with a gap pad >= 3 W/mK; contact area >= 0.013 m2 per unit (housing footprint ~ 115 x 115 mm)

cost.basis: ESTIMATES, no quote: Chinese MnZn power ferrite (large E sets) 6 USD/kg at 1k; litz with 0.05 mm strands 60 USD/kg of copper (fine-strand premium over LME copper 14.4 USD/kg on 2026-10-02, westmetall.com); Al housing + thermally conductive epoxy 12, former and barrier films 4, winding labour 12, vacuum potting + hipot/PD test 6 per unit
